auditor_rachel: Hi team 1 fieldwork request: for the March 14 incident we need a compact control map entry for SOC2 showing: RBAC remediation timeline (who/what/when), KMS rotation with cryptographic linkage proving post-rotation ciphertexts reference the new key version, immutable artifact snapshot + checksum + signed manifest, and the vuln-triage summary. Please include exact file locations and short audit queries we can paste into the binder.

noah: We can assemble that. High-level artifacts: terraform plan/apply diff (redacted), cloud audit events for IAM, KMS Encrypt/ReEncrypt entries, WORM copy of evidence bundle, bundle.sha256, manifest.json and manifest.json.sig (GPG-signed). Paths will be under s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6178901234/.

viv: RBAC: rolebinding remove done by terraform apply at 2025-03-14T09:04:22Z by ops@redwood.com. Remote-state diff exported to s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6178901234/terraform-diff.txt. CloudTrail query we ran: 
```
filter eventName in (DetachRolePolicy, DeleteRolePolicy) and eventTime between \"2025-03-14T09:00:00Z\" and \"2025-03-14T09:10:00Z\"
```
Matched event ids: e4f1a2c3-77aa-4b2c-9d88-01f2a3b4c5d6 (exported to iam-events.json.gz).

noah: KMS: we promoted CMK version v5 as primary at 2025-03-14T09:12:03Z. CloudTrail Encrypt/ReEncrypt events include requestParameters.destinationKeyVersionId which ends with \":5\" for post-rotation writes. We also preserved x-amz-meta-kms-key-version:5 in object metadata on uploads that occurred after rotation. Exported to kms-events.jsonl. Short CloudTrail snippet: 
```
{ eventTime: \"2025-03-14T09:12:05Z\", eventName: \"Encrypt\", requestParameters: { destinationKeyVersionId: \"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789:5\" } }
```

logs-bot: auto-export: uploaded s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6178901234/iam-events.json.gz (sha256: b6a2c5...); s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6178901234/kms-events.jsonl (sha256: d9f7e1...); s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6178901234/terraform-diff.txt (sha256: 8c3d4f...).

ops-gpg-bot: Signed manifest details: manifest.json lists filenames + sha256 checksums; manifest.json.sig is an ASCII-armored GPG signature signed with ops@redwood.com (GPG fingerprint: 4C2D 8A9F 0E12 3B4C 5D6E 7F80 1234 5678 9ABC DDEF, key id 0x9ABCDEF0). manifest.json.sig stored at s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/6178901234/manifest.json.sig. We also created a write-once copy in s3://redwood-worm/6178901234/bundle.tar.gz with Object Lock in Governance mode (365d retention). bundle.tar.gz.sha256 present alongside.

viv: Vulnerability triage: INC-6178901234/triage.md contains the assessment. Short summary: CVE-2025-0812 in base image redwood/serving:2.7; triage classified as high; mitigation = rebuild image (v2.7.1) and rolling restart completed at 2025-03-14T09:45:00Z. Deploy logs exported to deploy-log.txt.gz.

auditor_rachel: Two clarifications: 1) For RBAC we need the exact terraform apply snippet showing the removal (redacted is fine) and the apply timestamp. 2) For KMS we need a single ciphertext envelope or CloudTrail event demonstrating new key version in use (not only key rotation API). Can you paste a small redacted terraform diff line and one redacted CloudTrail entry here?

noah: Terraform snippet (redacted): 
```
- resource \"aws_iam_role_policy_attachment\" \"svcacct_attach\" {
-   role       = \"svc-pod-readonly\"
-   policy_arn = \"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/ReadOnlyAccess\"
- }
+ (removed)
apply timestamp: 2025-03-14T09:04:22Z
```
CloudTrail sample (redacted): 
```
{ eventTime: \"2025-03-14T09:12:05Z\", eventName: \"Encrypt\", userIdentity: {arn: \"arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ops-role/ops\"}, requestParameters: { destinationKeyVersionId: \"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789:5\" } }
```

ops-gpg-bot: Verification steps for the auditor will be included: 1) gpg --keyserver keys.redwood.com --recv-keys 0x9ABCDEF0; gpg --verify manifest.json.sig manifest.json; 2) sha256sum bundle.tar.gz | compare to bundle.tar.gz.sha256; 3) grep for \":5\" in kms-events.jsonl to show Encrypt/ReEncrypt entries referencing version 5; 4) match terraform-diff.txt line and apply timestamp to iam-events.json.gz.

auditor_rachel: Perfect 44d. Please produce a one-page plain-text control map entry with these fields: Control ID, Incident ID, Summary of change, Evidence files (with presigned links and hashes), Exact audit queries (copy/paste), Retention and WORM details, Cryptographic assertions (GPG fingerprint, KMS key ARN + version), Redactions, Owner. Paste it here when ready so I can drop into the SOC2 binder.

viv: On it 4dd512. Will post the final control map in ~20 minutes including presigned links (48h) and the tiny ciphertext envelope sample. Leaving thread open. Thanks all.
